description: A placeholder for what the mapping deliberately does not do: a Medicaid member whose name and address each come back in one piece, which are shown and never split, and whose date of birth is in a form this tool does not read as a date, which is kept as received and said to be so.
basis: Synthetic. Every value in this file is invented and no real member was used to make it. The shape of the response is one the mapping tolerates, not one observed from the member API, whose contract is not final.
